generalisation.note: general lyric rule: piece reuse between lines + route camera, on the beat

visual.notes: Dense frames of every change: reused pieces found automatically (辶 relays 道→进→追→过, 亻 你→做, 口 时→叫, plus dots) fly to their new characters and flush red; the donor characters show the gap (进 → 井, 追 → 自) — reuse reads literally; old line recedes to half size fading while the new one forms (overlap; no vanish flags); camera flies the route with a little bank; dashed route draws behind; all on the beat (lands on the downbeat). Original placeholder lines, user's own track. Weak: few big shared pieces per pair with these lines — the effect depends on the lyrics.
